top_signals.title: Fed Unanimously Raises Rates by a Quarter Point
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve voted unanimously to raise interest rates by a quarter percentage point and penciled in an additional hike later this year, steps aimed at containing inflation that will test Chairman Kevin Warsh’s relationship with President Donald Trump. The benchmark federal funds rate is now in a range of 3.75% to 4%. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: France Extends Fuel Aid for Sectors Impacted by Mideast Conflict
top_signals.summary: France’s government extended targeted aid for sectors most hurt by the latest rise in fuel prices due to the Middle East conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed raises rates for first time since 2023 in unanimous decision
top_signals.summary: Central bank chair Kevin Warsh defies calls from Donald Trump to lower borrowing costs
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasuries Hold Gains as Fed Hikes Rates, Signaling More Ahead
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries held their gains after the Federal Reserve lifted interest rates for the first time since 2023 and forecast further action to rein in inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: Ursula von der Leyen describes AI as ‘second tipping point of our time’ after climate change
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
